description: "In the Days of My Youth: A Novel" by Amelia B. Edwards is a fictional narrative written in the late 19th century. The story introduces readers to the author’s reflections on her childhood in a picturesque English village called Saxonholme, highlighting a deep connection to her heritage and surroundings.
